name: Hermes, Overseer of Elpis
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and vigilance.
Whenever you attack with one or more Birds, scry 2.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and vigilance.

needs.what: a token definition for a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and vigilance -- id `bird_1_1_u_flying_vigilance`, name "Bird Token", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Bird"], colors ["U"], color_identity ["U"], power 1, toughness 1, keywords ["flying", "vigilance"], is_token true -- added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json so `create_token` can name it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` carries only `token`, `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller` and `tapped`; the `token` value is an id string naming a card already in the pool, and there is no inline token body nor any size, colour, subtype or keyword override on the op. `token_ids` is a closed list and the loader rejects an id that is absent, so the card cannot ship ahead of the definition. The pool's only Bird is `bird_1_1_w_flying` -- right body and tribe, but white and without vigilance -- and its only 1/1 blue flier is `illusion_1_1_u_flying`, which is an Illusion rather than a Bird. Neither substitution is safe here in a way that goes beyond cosmetics: this card's second ability counts Birds you attack with, so shipping the Illusion would silently disconnect the two halves of the card, and shipping the white Bird would put the wrong colour (and a missing vigilance, which changes whether the token can attack and still block) on every token the card makes. The only other token with both flying and vigilance is `angel_4_4_w_flying_vigilance`, wrong on colour, tribe and size.
needs.blocks_only: the token clause; the rest of the card is expressible today

notes: The token is the ONLY blocker -- both triggers, and the whole rest of the card, are expressible with today's vocabulary. Once `bird_1_1_u_flying_vigilance` exists in the pool the answer is: {"card": {"id": "hermes_overseer_of_elpis", "name": "Hermes, Overseer of Elpis", "oracle_text": "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and vigilance.\nWhenever you attack with one or more Birds, scry 2.", "mana_cost": "{3}{U}", "types": ["Creature"], "supertypes": ["Legendary"], "subtypes": ["Elder", "Wizard"], "power": 2, "toughness": 4, "colors": ["U"], "color_identity": ["U"], "abilities": [{"kind": "triggered", "text": "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 blue Bird creature token with flying and vigilance.", "trigger": {"event": "spell_cast", "controller": "you", "filter": {"not_types": ["Creature"]}}, "effects": [{"op": "create_token", "token": "bird_1_1_u_flying_vigilance", "amount": {"const": 1}}]}, {"kind": "triggered", "text": "Whenever you attack with one or more Birds, scry 2.", "trigger": {"event": "you_attack", "filter": {"subtypes": ["Bird"]}}, "effects": [{"op": "scry", "amount": {"const": 2}}]}]}, "expectation": {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}}. The expectation cannot assert a token or a scry: the harness casts one card and stops, and the card under test is itself a creature spell, so the first trigger does not see a noncreature cast and combat is declined so the second never fires -- `{"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}` is the honest reading of the sandbox position (32 permanents plus Hermes).
